note: Always-on cost as printed by `claude plugin details tamirs-superpowers`: the name, description and when_to_use of every skill and agent, paid by every session before any skill fires (hooks and MCP tool schemas are not counted). The official marketplace highlights a plugin's context cost to users once always-on reaches 2,000 tokens; 2,000 is the figure to drive down to. History: 8,279 on 2026-10-17 (claude 2.1.302) with an 8,500 ceiling; two new skills (diagnose-objective, and a permission-levels skill removed again in #409) took it to 8,668 on claude 2.1.319 unnoticed, because CI's CLI has no credentials and prints a chars/4 fallback (~5,945) instead of a tokenizer count (issue #401). Description trims brought it to 7,298 and the ceiling down to 8,000. CI now holds the checkout to the ceiling offline: scripts/always-on-cost.py rebuilds the measured text and divides by chars_per_token, set a little below the ratio observed on claude 2.1.319 (2.735-2.748) so the estimate reads high; a live run fails if that stops being true. Lower the ceiling as the cost comes down; never raise it without updating this note. Refresh always_on_tokens/measured_on/measured_at with `bash scripts/check-token-budget.sh --update` on a signed-in machine.
